Explain in a short self-contained paragraph why a bicycle tyre feels softer on a cold morning, without numbers. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: Cold air causes the gas molecules inside the tyre to move slower and exert less pressure on the inner walls. This reduction in internal pressure makes the rubber casing feel noticeably softer and more pliable to the touch during chilly morning conditions.
